evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/workflow-automation/pages/AutomationRulesPage.tsx:56 — confirmDelete/handleToggle/handleRun await mutateAsync (delete/update/run) with no try/catch and no onError; on failure the promise rejects unhandled and the user gets no feedback (destructive delete silently fails, confirm modal stays open).

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/disputes/pages/CreateDisputePage.tsx:34 — handleSubmit fakes filing via `await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000))` then navigates to /disputes, never calling any create-dispute API; all form data (respondentId/title/description/desiredResolution) is silently discarded while showing a success navigation.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/disputes/pages/index.ts:6 — CreateDisputePage is exported from the feature's public surface, but the routed create flow (/disputes/new) uses FileDisputePageRoute instead, leaving this a stubbed duplicate page that would file nothing if wired.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/workflow-automation/pages/TemplateLibraryPage.tsx:53 — handleUseTemplate awaits createFromTemplate.mutateAsync with no error handling (same pattern in ExecutionMonitoringPage.tsx:74 handleRetry); on failure navigation never occurs and no error is surfaced to the user.

deferred_findings.note: workflow-automation pages (AutomationRulesPage.tsx, TemplateLibraryPage.tsx, ExecutionMonitoringPage.tsx) hardcode all user-facing English strings with no useTranslation, while ppt-web uses react-i18next across ~20 files. Below the 3-finding cap this run.
